mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (buyer_id, seller_id, product_id, price, status, address, remark) VALUES (#{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{productId}, #{price}, #{status}, #{address}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, p.title as product_title, p.images as product_images FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, p.title as product_title, p.images as product_images, s.nickname as seller_nickname FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user s ON o.seller_id = s.id WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT o.*, p.title as product_title, p.images as product_images, b.nickname as buyer_nickname FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user b ON o.buyer_id = b.id WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
